Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely declared the task complete and selected the correct answer (A) without performing any systematic analysis or utilizing the available capabilities (WebSurfer, FileSurfer, Coder, CodeExecutor) to verify the scientific principles behind solar eclipses. The Planner jumped straight to a conclusion based on a single sentence of internal reasoning rather than a structured investigation, violating the operational constraints of the multi-agent system.
